review_type: Independent AI-assisted read-only code/equation and saved-receipt review; not external human peer review

mathematical_checks.name: Physical sheet normalization
mathematical_checks.derivation: With q=D_ls/D_os and physical sheet s=kappa/(D_ol q), alpha_sheet=s(x-D_ol theta_c) gives q alpha_sheet=kappa(theta-theta_c). kappa is dimensionless convergence for this source plane; s has units Mpc^-1.

mathematical_checks.name: Potential-gradient-Hessian consistency
mathematical_checks.derivation: The added potential is one half s |x-D_ol theta_c|^2. Its physical gradient is s(x-D_ol theta_c) and Hessian is s I, exactly as returned by ConventionalSheetLens.application. Body and sheet use the same center.

mathematical_checks.name: Canonical Fermat and observer-clock normalization
mathematical_checks.derivation: For scalar maps the retained time-delay matrix is (1+z_l)D_ol/q. The code uses this through lens_application for both geometric and encounter contributions. Relative times cancel the arbitrary common potential/source constant. No independent H0 or delay scale is fitted.

mathematical_checks.name: Fixed physical injection versus fitted inverse source
mathematical_checks.derivation: The injection is read without changing the physical source, spectrum, redshifts, clock or maps. The inverse source coordinate changes by D_os ARCSEC delta_beta_arcsec, so delta_beta is exactly the stated angular nuisance. A compensating fitted source describes a different inverse-model preparation, not a retuned injected state.

mathematical_checks.name: Finite mass-sheet identity
mathematical_checks.derivation: At zero center, M -> lambda M, R fixed, beta -> lambda beta and kappa -> 1-lambda give the exact angular potential transformation lambda psi + (1-lambda)|theta|^2/2. Images are invariant and relative Fermat times scale by lambda, as the first test checks. This is not a second independent clock-rescaling parameter.

mathematical_checks.name: Five original rows
mathematical_checks.derivation: The optimizer evaluates theta-beta-G alpha=0 at the three injected axial positions and two relative arrival-time equations. The row units are arcsec for the lens residuals and days for delays. Numerical divisors 0.001 arcsec and 0.1 day condition the solve; they are not measurement covariance or a forecast.

mathematical_checks.name: Independent forward root application
mathematical_checks.derivation: After the inverse solve, brentq independently re-solves each of the three provided branches in a plus/minus 0.01 arcsec interval about its injected position. The output does not simply copy fitted observed positions. It uses the same canonical lens kernel; it is not an independently implemented optical theory or a global search for every possible root.

mathematical_checks.name: Bounded nonlinear domain
mathematical_checks.qualification: The evaluated solution is far inside these bounds. All transverse coordinates are zero by the declared axial, scalar-map domain; this is not a nonaxisymmetric population fit.

interpretation_checks.free_center: Five adjustable coordinates fitting five independent axial scalar observables is a saturated local inverse example. The full-rank finite Jacobian supports a local finite solution here; it is not evidence of a general all-lens degeneracy or a measured posterior.
interpretation_checks.fixed_center: Removing the center gives four coordinates for five rows. The remaining millisecond mismatch belongs to this restricted numerical row weighting and profile family; it is not a detectable or irreducible BHSM signal.
interpretation_checks.stronger_equivalence: The separately derived positive effective-mass construction, not this saturated fit alone, supports complete retained-field equivalence for all incident rays.
interpretation_checks.order: This inverse application uses the saved leading screened injection. It does not execute scalar higher-order fields or a new GR2 inverse comparison.
interpretation_checks.double_counting: The one physical sheet is added only to the encounter. The original propagation maps are not modified by an additional duplicate sheet.

assessed_purposes: Recovery of a finite independently generated conventional injection
Finite R1 inverse fit followed by original-row/forward-root checks
Remaining restricted-profile residual with the center fixed

limitations_not_errors: Independent root application means a separately solved root problem on the same physical kernel, not independently developed lens physics.
Only the three declared noncritical axial branches are verified; the implementation is not a global root-census theorem.
Near machine-precision fit residuals are reproducibility diagnostics, not astrophysical accuracy or observational information.
The recovered nuisance parameters are one local representation under the declared bounds and row scales; no uncertainty estimate or unique physical source/galaxy is inferred.
recommendation: Retain the result as a concrete finite identifiability application, with the existing saturated-example and positive-halo qualifications. No scientific correction is required from this review.
